title: Law & Order Dun Dun
blurb: DUN DUN. Two notes meaning a crime has occurred and justice is now in motion. Composer Mike Post built it from layered sounds — reportedly including a jail door slamming — which is why it lands with such institutional weight. The internet uses it as a gavel: play it after any accusation, verdict, or petty judgment in the group chat and "you ate my leftovers" becomes a felony proceeding. Few three-second stings carry this much implied paperwork. Iconic, authoritative, and endlessly funny out of context.
origin: The scene-change sting from Law & Order, created by composer Mike Post.
